title: Approval of the Acceptance of a Grant Award from the US Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance: Covering Community Project Funding/Congressional Directed Spending Program funds of $963,00
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Acceptance of a Grant Award from the US Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance: Covering Community Project Funding/Congressional Directed Spending Program funds of $963,000 for purchase of vehicle fleet, upgrades, and equipment for the Airport Police Division at Los Angeles International Airport (Antoinette Chandler)
summary: Airport police will receive a $963,000 federal Justice Department grant to buy patrol vehicles, equipment and upgrades for the LAX police division.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
